items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Stocks told Harold Oxley and Jimmie Lunsford, now, your drummer got to have some drums up there... So went to work and I, you know, I took it upon myself to go and buy a whole complete set of Leedy drums

ctx.x: Now, going back to Cotton Club. Now,

He stood -- as he came through the door, came upstairs, he stood against the wall, over -- with his overcoat over his or either topcoat over his arm, dressed to kill, hair gleaming. Good looking man. And he just stood there, listened to the band. He didn't say anything or do anything, he and Herman Stocks. And so, (inaudible) well, he could make us or break us.
But one night Herman Stocks got so mad with Harold Oxley, he told him, take that band and get out of here. (Inaudible) squirmed.
